key_insight: A two-stage synthesize-and-reground pipeline lets you generate faithful, focused QA pairs from scientific document fragments and then programmatically re-embed them into full-document multimodal tasks, resolving the scale–faithfulness–realism trade-off for dataset creation.
problem_solved: Creates large, realistic, and faithful training/evaluation data for scientific multimodal document reasoning, addressing the trade-off between dataset scale, annotation faithfulness, and real-document realism.
method: Claim-Centric QA Synthesis: generate isolated, faithful QA pairs and chain-of-thought style reasoning grounded on focused document segments (figures, tables, paragraphs).
Document-Scale Regrounding: programmatically re-embed synthesized QA into entire documents to form full-document tasks that preserve context, distractors, and multimodal layout.
Benchmarking & Evaluation: produce a dataset and evaluation protocol (SciMDR) to measure model performance on realistic multimodal scientific reasoning.
impact: Enables training and robust evaluation of foundation models on realistic scientific multimodal reasoning tasks, improving downstream performance and trustworthiness for research and industry applications.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing two stages: (1) Claim-centric QA synthesis from a segment, (2) Document-scale regrounding into full multimodal document.
Before/after example: isolated QA with grounding vs. regrounded QA inside a full paper page (text + figure + table).
Bar/line chart comparing dataset scale vs. faithfulness/realism trade-offs (baseline methods vs. synthesize-and-reground).
Performance table or radar chart showing benchmark results across multimodal reasoning metrics (accuracy, faithfulness, robustness).
paper_title: SciMDR: Benchmarking and Advancing Scientific Multimodal Document Reasoning
paper_authors: Ziyu Chen, Yilun Zhao, Chengye Wang, Rilyn Han, Manasi Patwardhan
